comment.narrative: 28100 households were triggered through Community Led Total Sanitation program to reach the ODF status in 796 targeted communities in 4 pilot districts. description.narrative: 1.3. Number of beneficiary communities in targeted areas with access to clean water and sanitation

comment.narrative: Over 800 communities were triggered through Community Led Total Sanitation program to reach the ODF status in 796 targeted communities in 4 pilot districts. Communities were encouraged to built basic hand washing facility like tippy taps nearby toilets. All 796 communities having over 28100 households were certified as ODF free during programme implementation. There was no direct water supply component in EU I programme. However 20 communities were supported by rehabilitation of gravity fed water supply systems with the contingency support provided by EU during COVID19 response work.
